title: Teletext
description: A teletext service about the Beatles on a 40 by 25 grid: eight colours, double-height banners and every album cover redrawn as block mosaics. Type a page number and the header rolls through the carousel until your page arrives row by row.
intent: Teletext rendered for real: control codes decoded the way the chip did it, a hand-set character set with diagonal smoothing, covers converted to mosaics under the genuine one-cell-per-colour-change rule, the live clock ticking in the header, and only a faint CRT softness around it.
sources: herb reference board: fa23 Y2K montage (CRT text screens)
